content.title: Pyramids & Nile Cruise Discovery
content.summary: Pyramids, Islamic Cairo and a three-night Nile cruise: an 8-day journey through Cairo, Aswan and Luxor, connected by overnight sleeping trains.
content.description:
Discover the wonders of ancient Egypt on an unforgettable 8-day journey through Cairo, Aswan, and Luxor. From the legendary Pyramids of Giza and the Great Sphinx to the magnificent temples lining the Nile, this carefully planned itinerary brings together Egypt's most celebrated monuments, rich cultural heritage, and timeless river landscapes.

Begin your adventure in Cairo, where the last surviving Wonder of the Ancient World awaits. Explore the grandeur of Islamic Cairo, with its historic mosques, centuries-old streets, and the lively atmosphere of Khan El Khalili Bazaar. Then travel south aboard an overnight sleeping train to Aswan, where the majestic Philae Temple and the impressive High Dam introduce you to the beauty and history of Upper Egypt.

The highlight of your journey is a three-night Nile cruise from Aswan towards Luxor. Relax on board as you sail through the heart of Egypt, stopping to explore the remarkable temples of Kom Ombo and Edfu. Along the way, admire the changing scenery of the Nile Valley, where traditional villages and palm-lined riverbanks create an unforgettable setting.

Your adventure continues in Luxor, home to some of the world's most extraordinary archaeological treasures. Explore the royal tombs of the Valley of the Kings, admire the elegant Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, and stand before the monumental columns of Karnak Temple and the impressive Luxor Temple.

With guided sightseeing, arranged transportation, a three-night Nile cruise, and overnight train journeys connecting Cairo with Upper Egypt, this package offers a rewarding way to experience Egypt's extraordinary past while enjoying the landscapes and cultural traditions that make the country unique.

All meals are included, from dinner on arrival day through breakfast on departure day. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are included on every full day in between.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Cairo
itinerary.description:
Your Egyptian adventure begins upon arrival at Cairo International Airport, where our representative will welcome you and assist with your arrival arrangements. Enjoy a comfortable transfer to your hotel, where you can settle in and prepare for the remarkable experiences ahead.

Meals: Dinner | Overnight: Cairo hotel

itinerary.title: The Pyramids of Giza & Great Sphinx
itinerary.description:
Today, step into the world of the ancient pharaohs with a visit to the legendary Giza Plateau. Marvel at the extraordinary Pyramids of Giza, monuments that have fascinated travelers for thousands of years, and admire the Great Sphinx, one of Egypt's most recognizable symbols. After exploring these iconic landmarks, enjoy lunch before returning to your hotel. The remainder of the day is free for you to relax or spend time at leisure in Cairo.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Cairo hotel

itinerary.title: The Treasures of Islamic Cairo & Overnight Train to Aswan
itinerary.description:
Discover another fascinating side of Egypt as you explore the architectural and cultural treasures of Islamic Cairo. Visit the magnificent Mosque of Sultan Hassan, admire the neighboring Al-Rifa'i Mosque, and explore the historic Mosque of Ahmed Ibn Tulun, one of Cairo's most remarkable Islamic monuments. Continue through the lively Khan El Khalili Bazaar and the atmospheric Al-Muizz Street, where historic buildings, traditional shops, and centuries of local heritage reveal Cairo's enduring character. Enjoy lunch before transferring to Cairo Railway Station to board your overnight sleeping train to Aswan.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Sleeping train to Aswan

itinerary.title: Aswan Highlights & Nile Cruise Embarkation
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Aswan, a beautiful city on the Nile known for its peaceful atmosphere and remarkable archaeological heritage. After meeting your representative at the railway station, begin your sightseeing with a visit to the Aswan High Dam, one of Egypt's major modern engineering achievements. Continue to the enchanting Philae Temple, dedicated to the goddess Isis and set in a picturesque location surrounded by Nile waters. After sightseeing, transfer to your Nile cruise ship and embark on your three-night journey along the river. Enjoy lunch and dinner on board as you settle into your floating accommodation.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Nile cruise

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise & Kom Ombo Temple
itinerary.description:
Enjoy the special experience of traveling through Egypt aboard your Nile cruise, following the ship's sailing schedule through the remarkable landscapes of Upper Egypt. Today's sightseeing includes a visit to Kom Ombo Temple, an unusual ancient sanctuary dedicated to two deities: Sobek, the crocodile god, and Horus the Elder. Discover the temple's fascinating carvings and distinctive architecture before continuing your Nile cruise journey. Lunch and dinner are served on board, with another overnight stay aboard the ship.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Nile cruise

itinerary.title: Edfu Temple & Sailing Towards Luxor
itinerary.description:
Continue your Nile journey with a visit to the impressive Temple of Edfu, dedicated to Horus, the falcon-headed god. Among Egypt's best-preserved ancient temples, Edfu offers a remarkable opportunity to appreciate the monumental architecture and religious traditions of the ancient Egyptians. Following your visit, continue sailing towards Luxor according to the cruise itinerary. Enjoy time aboard the ship as the Nile Valley unfolds around you. Lunch and dinner are served on board.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Nile cruise

itinerary.title: Luxor's Royal Tombs & Magnificent Temples
itinerary.description:
After arriving in Luxor and disembarking from your Nile cruise, prepare for a full day exploring some of Egypt's most extraordinary archaeological sites. Begin on Luxor's West Bank with a visit to the Valley of the Kings, the famous royal burial ground of the New Kingdom pharaohs. Continue to the spectacular Temple of Queen Hatshepsut, built against the dramatic cliffs of Deir el-Bahari, and stop to admire the towering Colossi of Memnon. Following lunch, cross to Luxor's East Bank to visit the immense Karnak Temple complex, celebrated for its monumental columns and grand ceremonial spaces. Continue to Luxor Temple, another remarkable testament to the architectural achievements of ancient Egypt. After completing your sightseeing, transfer to Luxor Railway Station to board your overnight sleeping train back to Cairo.

Meals: Breakfast, lunch and dinner | Overnight: Sleeping train to Cairo

itinerary.title: Return to Cairo & Departure
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Cairo Railway Station, bringing your memorable journey through Egypt's ancient cities and Nile Valley to a close. Enjoy free time at leisure until your final departure. Return home with lasting memories of the Pyramids, the historic streets of Cairo, the beautiful Nile, and the magnificent temples of Upper Egypt.

Meals: Breakfast

inclusions: 2 nights aboard sleeping trains: Cairo–Aswan and Luxor–Cairo.
All transfers as per the program.
Entrance fees to the mentioned sightseeing sites.
All meals from dinner on arrival day through breakfast on departure day, including breakfast, lunch and dinner on each full day in between.
exclusions: Any services not mentioned in the program.
content.bookingTerms:
Availability
Tours are available throughout the year except from 24 December to 7 January, inclusive. All bookings are subject to availability and confirmation.

Payment
A deposit of 25% of the total tour price is required upon confirmation. The remaining balance must be paid 30 days before departure.

Cancellation
Cancellation charges are calculated as a percentage of the total tour price, based on the number of days before departure when cancellation is received:
• 60 or more days: no cancellation charge; full refund.
• 59–30 days: 25% of the total tour price.
• 29–15 days: 50% of the total tour price.
• 14–7 days: 75% of the total tour price.
• 6 days or fewer: 100% of the total tour price.
Any refund or outstanding cancellation charge is calculated against the amount already paid.

Children’s policy
Children under 2 years old: free of charge.
Children aged 2 to under 6: 25% of the applicable adult tour price.
Children aged 6 to under 12: 50% of the applicable adult tour price.
Travelers aged 12 or older: full adult tour price.
These child rates apply when sharing a room with parents, with a maximum of one child sharing the parents’ room. If a tour includes airfare, additional child airfare charges may apply. Please contact us to confirm room arrangements and a family quote; the online group-rate calculator currently uses full adult rates.

Date changes
Date changes are available, subject to availability. Administration fees may apply depending on the travel period for which the tour is booked. Please contact us to confirm available dates and any applicable fees before a change is made.

Force majeure
We offer a flexible cancellation approach when travel is affected by circumstances beyond the traveler's control, such as government restrictions, airline disruptions, official do-not-travel warnings, war or civil unrest. Each case is reviewed individually, taking into account the circumstances and applicable supplier arrangements. Please contact us promptly to discuss available cancellation or rescheduling options.
